title: Project Registry Entry
description: M10.1 canonical per-project record. One file per project on both sides of the sync boundary: local at $XDG_STATE_HOME/agent-continuity/registry/{project_uuid}.json; VM at $AGENT_CONTINUITY_VM_PATH/sessions/{project_uuid}/registry-entry.json. Synced via `scripts/sync.sh push --artifact project-registry` and the matching pull. Structured merge: scalar metadata fields use LWW by last_writer_ts (with last_writer_device alphabetical tiebreak); repos[] union by origin; observed_paths[] within each repo dedupe by device_id (one preferred path per repo per device, LWW by observed_at). The aggregate at core/schemas/project-registry.schema.json is now a derived view; per-project entries are canonical. Project identity is GLOBAL (uuid + repo origin); paths are device-local observations.

uuid.description: Canonical project identifier — global, stable. Format: 'proj-{kebab-name}-{epoch-tail}'. The key for cross-device matching: a project is the same project on device A and device B iff this string matches.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the project was first registered (any device).

last_active.description: ISO-8601 UTC: last time any device touched this project. Distinct from last_writer_ts, which is specifically 'who pushed this record version on sync.'

last_writer_device.description: device_id of the device that wrote this record version. The merge tiebreak key when last_writer_ts is equal.

last_writer_ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the write that produced this record version. The LWW key for scalar fields. Required to participate in M10.1 merge; entries without it are treated as the oldest possible (always lose).

last_device.description: M3-legacy field carrying 'any device touched this' semantics. Retained for compatibility readers; M10.1 merge does NOT consult this field — last_writer_device + last_writer_ts are the merge keys.

files_fingerprint.description: Optional sha256 hex digest of a fingerprint over the project's files. Format suggestion: 'sha256:{64-hex}'. Validator does not enforce the pattern.

repos.description: Git repos associated with this project. Merge key is origin (the canonical git URL). observed_paths within each repo are per-device facts.

owners.description: Authorized humans for this project (e.g. email addresses).

origin.description: Canonical git remote URL (e.g. 'git@github.com:org/repo.git', 'https://github.com/org/repo.git'). Secondary global identifier — devices can match projects on origin even if uuids drift.

observed_paths.description: Per-device path observations. Each entry says 'on device X, this repo lives at path Y as of observed_at.' Merge key within an origin is device_id; one preferred path per repo per device for M10.1 v1 (multi-clone per device deferred to a future role/workspace_id field).

device_id.description: Which device this observation came from. Matches device-identity.device_id on that device.

path.description: Local filesystem path on the named device. NOT portable — only valid for that device_id. Other devices ignore this string's actual filesystem semantics on themselves.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC when this device observed the path. LWW key within (origin, device_id): newer observation wins.
